'''Skettos''' were medium-sized, [[Blood/Legends|blood]]-sucking flying [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] that dwelled in the caverns of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Only emerging at daybreak and twilight, they possessed many rods in their eyes to assist their vision in low-light conditions as they ate airborne insects. Though reptilian, they were warm-blooded and gave birth to a single offspring at a time.<ref name="Wildlife" />

Skettos would often gather loose [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] wool for nests.

[[File:Sketto2-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Sketto swarm.]]
Sketto tended to swarm with others of their kind to suck the blood of sleeping larger animals. Their large teeth helped to puncture tough hides, and legend had it that a sketto swarm could suck a sleeping [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] dry overnight.<ref name="Wildlife" /> They bled green blood.

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] a group of skettos that inhabited a cave, fled from one of the cave exits to escape an explosion caused by the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]] crashing his [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] into a pillar of stone.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>
